description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Sorceress's Knight], [Damage Cap +10000], [Switch Draw Mode (Fire, Dark)] and [Stubborn Blade Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Sorceress's Knight
description.text: Dark and Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Switch Draw Mode (Fire, Dark)

description.name: Stubborn Blade Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Stubborn Blade after using two Dark or Fire abilities
